desert_shadow_bat:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original low-resolution pixel-art dark fantasy RPG enemy animation sprite sheet.
Match our newly approved project sprites: grounded 16-bit RPG pixel art, crisp dark brown-black contours, compact angular pixel clusters, weathered materials, low-resolution 40-64 pixel body detail enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixel edges, restrained but varied colors. NOT chibi, smooth painting, vector, 3D, or modern glossy illustration.
Produce EXACTLY 6 evenly spaced columns x 4 evenly spaced rows = 24 COMPLETE individual animation poses. Prefer a 1536x1536 square TRUE TRANSPARENT canvas. Same character, camera, scale, anatomy, colors and gear in every frame; LEFT-facing three-quarter side view.
CRITICAL: each entire figure including wings, tail, branch crown and any extended weapon fits within the CENTRAL 60% OF ITS CELL WIDTH. Each cell must have at least 20% width CLEAR TRANSPARENT PADDING ON BOTH SIDES, including attack/death. Do not fill the canvas with touching large figures. Draw each individual SMALLER so there are broad transparent gutters BETWEEN EVERY CHARACTER. Every body part inside the cell, nothing at canvas edges. No grid, lines, text, labels, shadows, ground or background. Do not bake checkerboard into alpha.
Rows top to bottom, 6 ordered frames each: IDLE, MOVE, ATTACK, DIE. Idle/move loop smoothly. Attack six poses: ready, windup, start strike, decisive contact toward LEFT, follow-through, recover to initial ready stance. Death six poses: alive recoil, lose balance, fall, hit ground, settle, complete motionless corpse. A clear body remains visible, not only a head. Consistent root position within cells, ground baseline at 86% of each cell height. Animation must actually articulate joints/wings, not identical images shifted or squashed.

CHARACTER AND ACTION DETAILS:
One original SHADOW BAT (暗影蝠), a sinister small natural bat monster, compact charcoal-indigo furry body, recognizable pointed ears and little amber eyes, full symmetrical articulated forelimb wings in three-quarter LEFT view with dark plum/wine-red membranes, tiny claws and feet. Not a vampire person, dragon, bird, floating skull, or cute cartoon. Restrained indigo-charcoal/plum body with a few warm amber pixels. Complete wings always visible, even maximum span; make the whole bat small enough for its wing tips to stay within the central 60% of every cell.
IDLE six hovering wingbeat poses: high raised wings, half-down, wide spread, low cupped, upstroke, almost raised; head/body stays near a consistent hovering center around 50% of cell height, not standing on ground. MOVE is a different forward-flight wing cycle, body leans LEFT, wings sweep back, articulated fingers and membranes fold and unfold. ATTACK is a visible magical shriek/spit: hover ready, wings draw back, head recoils, jaws open toward LEFT with one tiny attached muted violet flash at the mouth, wings brace, close jaws and recover; no large detached projectile crossing cells. DIE: startled recoil in air, wings crumple, bat tilts and drops, lands at the 86% ground baseline, wings fold around body, final small full-body grounded bat corpse; no graphic gore.
Output ONLY this clean transparent 24-frame sprite sheet.
